about: M0 runs as measured, each with the load average it ran under (scripts/m0-run.mjs)

runs.name: run2-measure
runs.command: env TERRIEST_SPIKE_MEASURE=1 npx vitest run src/sim/measure.test.ts --reporter=verbose

runs.name: run5-audit
runs.command: npm run build && node scripts/audit.mjs --app-options --json results/audit.json

runs.name: run5-sizes
runs.command: npm run build && node scripts/sizes.mjs --json results/sizes.json

runs.name: run5-tokenizer
runs.command: node scripts/tokenizer-check.mjs && node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { checkFile } from './scripts/tokenizer-check.mjs'; const files = {}; for (const f of readdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }).map(String).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.js')).sort()) { const r = checkFile(readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8')); files[f] = { parsed: r.parsed, tokenized: r.tokenized, missedByTokenizer: r.missedByTokenizer, inventedByTokenizer: r.inventedByTokenizer, hostsInParsedStrings: r.parserFindings.hosts, rootAbsoluteInParsedStrings: r.parserFindings.paths }; } writeFileSync('results/tokenizer.json', JSON.stringify({ utc: new Date().toISOString(), about: 'hermet 11283ca jsStringLiterals against TypeScript parser strings, per built chunk (scripts/tokenizer-check.mjs)', files }, null, 1) + '\n');"

runs.name: run3-cost-1
runs.note: the spec wrote results/cost.json; renamed to results/cost-1.json before the repeat

runs.name: run5-audit
runs.command: npm run build > results/tmp/run5-audit-build.log 2>&1 && { node scripts/audit.mjs --app-options --json results/audit.json; echo "audit.mjs exit $? (1 = findings with no exceptions)"; } && node scripts/audit-classify.mjs
